# CANDIDATE: MARKET_STRUCTURE_BOS_RETEST_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a break of structure (BOS) to the downside, price often retests the broken level as new resistance, offering a short opportunity. This pattern exists because market participants view the prior swing low as a key reference level, and short sellers enter on the retest, expecting the downtrend to resume.

## Mechanism

Identify a BOS when price closes below the prior swing low (LH) and that low is marked as structure break; then wait for a retest: price moves back up to within 0.2% of the broken low and forms a bearish candle (close < open) with volume > average volume; enter short at next bar open. Exit: Stop at recent swing high (prior high before BOS) (chart-stop); TP1 at 1.5R (distance entry to stop), runner using premium-stop % (0.6%). Regime hint: Works best in trending markets (ribbon slope > 0.5) and VIX <22; avoid ranging days where ribbon is flat.
